organization.name: 2Connect
organization.description: A volunteering movement of young Kenyans. We connect young people to meaningful service, prepare them through training, support their wellbeing, and help them grow as leaders.

home.title: Volunteer opportunities for young people in Kenya
home.description: Find volunteer opportunities in Kenya that grow your skills and your CV. Free training, wellness support, campus clubs and internships for young changemakers.

about.label: About
about.title: About us, a youth movement built in Kenya
about.description: Meet 2Connect, a movement of young Kenyans who show up for their communities. Our story, our mission and a word from our founder, Kevin Wanjiru.

services.label: What we do
services.title: Volunteering, training, wellness and internships
services.description: Volunteer matching, 2CFP training, free wellness and peer support, internships and campus clubs. Find your way in and build experience that counts.

events.label: Events
events.title: Volunteer events, cleanups and workshops in Kenya
events.description: Cleanups, wellness workshops, leadership trainings and meetups across Kenya. Find a 2Connect event near you, bring a friend and show up.

gallery.label: Gallery
gallery.title: Gallery, moments from our community
gallery.description: Photos from 2Connect cleanups, workshops, trainings and outreach across Kenya. See what young people showing up together looks like.

contact.label: Contact
contact.title: Contact us to volunteer or partner
contact.description: Want to volunteer, partner with us or start a campus club? Email 2connectke@gmail.com or call +254 111 646 177. We would love to hear from you.
